name: moonshotai/kimi-k3
description: Kimi K3 is Moonshot AI's flagship model, a 2.8-trillion-parameter open-weight mixture-of-experts model with native visual understanding and a 1M-token context. It is built on Kimi Delta Attention, a hybrid linear attention, plus Attention Residuals, and always runs in thinking mode with selectable effort. Moonshot positions it for long-horizon coding across large codebases and terminal tools, visual software tasks such as frontend and game work, and end-to-end knowledge work.
